summary: The credential cold boots detect publication without its final flush

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make musl-programs && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} tests/musl/creddisk
exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run cred-persist "run: cred-persist: PASS"

faults.name: publish-flush
faults.summary: the renamed credential file is not flushed

lines: @etude 1 notrun final-no-lock an earlier boot failed
@etude 1 notrun final-no-temps an earlier boot failed
@etude 1 notrun final-released-bytes an earlier boot failed
